'''Hal''' was an [[officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy|starfleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] who fought in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[time]] of the [[First Order]], Hal's prowess had passed into history, and the [[Rank insignia of the First Order|commemorative armbands]] worn by [[squad leader]]s of the First Order's [[First Order military|military]] bore the officer's name in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="TFA VD" /> The rank insignia was worn by a [[Unidentified First Order officer (Finalizer)|First Order officer]] aboard the ''[[Finalizer]]'',<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> and officers [[Nastia Unamo]], [[Thanisson]],<ref name="TFA VD" /> [[Lank Paze]], and [[Rumitar Shay]].<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name Hal first appears on an armband worn by an unidentified bridge officer aboard the ''Finalizer'' in the [[2015]] film {{Film|7}}, although the last character is obscured.<ref name="TFA" /> The cuff title was further expanded upon in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="TFA VD /> The name seems to be a reference to Hal, the son of costume designer [[Glyn Dillon]],<ref name="Dillon">{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/BYtRMGjBZap|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|date=2017-09-06|quote=This is a new promotional poster for 'The Last Jedi' - I like it because they usually have Poe facing the other way... This way you get to see my boys names in Aurebesh ("Ro & Hal").|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/frsEk}}</ref> who worked on the film {{Film|7}}.<ref name="TFA" />
